summary: Conditional expressions that are literally None or an empty string evaluate as True and now emit a deprecation warning.
questions: What happens with an empty assert that?

answer_card.title: Empty conditionals are deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: A `when:` / `that:` that is **`None` or `""`** currently evaluates as **True** and now warns. Remove it or make it a real boolean expression.
